light: This is one ordinary frame pulled from a normal handheld video shot by a coworker with a consumer camera at eye level, simply recording what happens, not composing a photo. The framing is casual and a little off: something is cut by the edge of the frame. Almost everything in the frame is in focus, nothing blurred out: the room behind stays fully readable. The only light is what the place really has, and each person and object gets light according to where it stands; correctly exposed, white fluorescent tube light inside the shop plus daylight from the open front door. Colours of an ordinary video with automatic white balance and almost no correction: moderate contrast, soft highlights, mild sensor noise and light compression, faint motion blur on anything moving. Skin with pores and uneven tone; hair with stray curls; the khaki work shirt with real creases. People are caught mid-action, unposed.
look: Ordinary handheld video filmed by a coworker with a consumer camera at eye level, small natural shakes and casual slightly imperfect framing, everything in the room in focus, only the light the place really has, correctly exposed, automatic white balance, mild sensor noise; real skin and natural rough hands; he moves naturally and unposed, nothing staged; no music.

clips.text: Antes de empezar, vamos a la ferretería de la esquina. Son cuatro cosas, y no gastas mucho. Buenas tardes. Necesito dos lanas de acero sin jabón, una espuma de poliuretano,
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, leans on the counter talking to the camera, then turns to the shopkeeper and speaks to him, counting four items on his fingers. white fluorescent tube light inside the shop plus daylight from the open front door. He wears the same light khaki short-sleeve two-pocket work shirt with clear safety glasses pushed up on his forehead the whole time, same curly black-and-gray hair and short gray-black beard, same face as the reference.

clips.text: un burlete para puerta y una malla metálica fina. Mira, ésta es la lana de acero. Que sea sin jabón, la gruesa.

clips.text: El ratón muerde casi todo, pero esto le lastima los dientes y no lo puede sacar. La espuma va encima de la lana, para sellar. Sola no sirve: la muerde como si fuera pan.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, pulls the steel wool a little apart with his fingers showing how coarse it is, then puts it down and picks up the spray can of polyurethane foam and shakes it. white fluorescent tube light inside the shop plus daylight from the open front door. clips.text: Ya vas a ver por qué te lo digo. El burlete, para debajo de la puerta. Éste, con cepillo de goma. Y la malla, fina, de metal, no de plástico.
clips.action: Claudio, the man whose face is the third reference image, puts the can down and unrolls the door draft strip on the counter, a long aluminum strip with a rubber brush, running his thumb along the brush. white fluorescent tube light inside the shop plus daylight from the open front door. clips.text: En el Manual te dejé esta frase escrita, para que la lleves en el celular y no te vendan otra cosa. Y unos guantes, que la lana de acero corta.
